title: Books and meetings: retelling what people said
theme: Книги и встречи: пересказ книги, встречи и созвона
can_do: Пересказать, что сказали на встрече или созвоне, со сдвигом времен.
Передать вопрос и просьбу: She asked if..., He asked me to...
Точно назвать, как человек это сказал: admitted, denied, suggested, promised, warned.
Коротко пересказать сюжет книги или фильма.

points.title: Reported speech: tenses, questions and requests
points.explain_ru: Когда пересказываешь чужие слова после said или told, время обычно сдвигается на шаг назад: is → was, will → would, can → could, has done и did → had done. Меняются и слова времени и места: tomorrow → the next day, here → there. Если сказанное верно до сих пор, сдвиг можно не делать: She said the office is closed on Mondays. Вопрос пересказывают прямым порядком: She asked if I was free, He asked where the report was. Просьбу: asked/told + кто + to + глагол.

examples.en: She said she was too busy to join the call.
examples.ru: Она сказала, что слишком занята, чтобы подключиться к созвону.

examples.en: The client told us the budget would be approved the next day.
examples.ru: Клиент сказал нам, что бюджет утвердят на следующий день.

examples.en: Max said the team had already finished the design.
examples.ru: Макс сказал, что команда уже закончила дизайн.

examples.en: The director asked whether we could start earlier.
examples.ru: Директор спросил, можем ли мы начать раньше.

examples.en: She asked me to send the minutes by the evening.
examples.ru: Она попросила меня прислать протокол к вечеру.

ru_trap.wrong: He said me that the meeting was cancelled.
ru_trap.right: He told me that the meeting was cancelled.
ru_trap.why_ru: По-русски "сказал мне" звучит естественно. В английском said идет без "кому" (He said that...), а с "кому" нужен told: He told me that...

points.title: Reporting verbs and their patterns
points.explain_ru: Вместо said точнее назвать, что человек сделал словами. У каждого такого глагола свой шаблон. admit / deny + -ing: признал, отрицал. suggest + -ing или suggest that + кто + глагол: предложил. promise / refuse / agree / offer + to: пообещал, отказался, согласился, вызвался. remind / warn / advise / ask + кто + to: напомнил, предупредил, посоветовал, попросил. Шаблон надо учить вместе с глаголом.

examples.en: He admitted forgetting to update the ticket.
examples.ru: Он признал, что забыл обновить задачу.

examples.en: Lena suggested moving the meeting to Thursday.
examples.ru: Лена предложила перенести встречу на четверг.

examples.en: The vendor promised to send the fix by Friday.
examples.ru: Подрядчик пообещал прислать исправление к пятнице.

examples.en: The manager reminded everyone to fill in their timesheets.

ru_trap.wrong: She suggested me to call the client.
ru_trap.why_ru: Русское "предложила мне позвонить" тянет за собой схему "кто + to". Suggest ее не принимает: suggested calling или suggested that I call.

words.example: The plot is simple, but the characters are great.
The main character is a retired detective.
Her first novel was translated into ten languages.
I fell asleep in the middle of chapter three.
The author said the story was based on her own family.
It's a gripping story, I read it in two days.
The book is set in Lisbon in the 1950s.
Everyone in the club hated the ending.
A colleague recommended the book to me.
Can you give me a quick summary of the meeting?
She mentioned that the budget might change.
The designer pointed out that the button was too small.
Please don't bring up the budget in front of the client.
The client complained that the reports were late.
She explained why the release had been delayed.
According to the client, the old version was faster.
The pricing question wasn't on the agenda.
I'll send the minutes after the call.
Each action item has an owner and a date.
I'll follow up with the vendor tomorrow.
The main takeaway was that users need a simpler start.
Let me do a quick recap of what we agreed.

items.prompt: "I can't come tomorrow." Last week she told me she ___ come the next day.
"Where is the report?" Yesterday he asked me where the report ___. It's on his desk now, so he has found it.
He said me that the server was down.
answers: He told me that the server was down.
He told me the server was down.
He said that the server was down.
He said the server was down.
He said to me that the server was down.
He said to me the server was down.

items.prompt: The developer admitted ___ the wrong branch.
The vendor promised ___ (send) the update by Friday.
She suggested me to talk to the client.
answers: She suggested that I talk to the client.
She suggested that I should talk to the client.
She suggested I talk to the client.
She suggested I should talk to the client.
She suggested talking to the client.
